rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) with no injury or third-party involvement is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang on 1/6/24; four shingles blown off with no interior water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. No secondary damage reported.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
